text: Hvordan slutter ordsproget »Mange bække små gør en stor …«?
gloss: How does the proverb 'Many small streams make a big …' end? — å (a river): many small contributions add up to something big.

text: Hvilken af disse både har et navn, der staves ens forfra og bagfra?
gloss: Which of these boats has a name spelled the same forwards and backwards? — Kajak: a palindrome; checking each word reversed settles it.

text: Hvem skrev eventyrene om den grimme ælling og kejserens nye klæder?
gloss: Who wrote the fairy tales of the ugly duckling and the emperor's new clothes? — H.C. Andersen, the Danish storyteller.

text: Hvilken svensk by ligger i den anden ende af Øresundsbroen, set fra København?
gloss: Which Swedish city lies at the other end of the Øresund Bridge, seen from Copenhagen? — Malmö. Helsingborg is only linked to Helsingør by ferry.

text: Hvem er hjernen i Olsen-banden, ham der altid har »en plan«?
gloss: Who is the brain of the Olsen Gang, the one who always has 'a plan'? — Egon Olsen; Benny and Kjeld are his partners, Børge is Kjeld's son.

text: En landmand har 17 køer. Alle på nær ni bliver solgt. Hvor mange køer har han tilbage?
gloss: A farmer has 17 cows. All but nine are sold. How many are left? — 9: 'all but nine' means nine remain. 8 is the autopilot trap (17 - 9).

text: Hvilket af disse dyr er ikke et insekt?
gloss: Which of these animals is not an insect? — The spider: it has eight legs and is an arachnid; insects have six.

text: Hvilken romersk arena, kendt for gladiatorkampe, kan man stadig besøge i Rom?
gloss: Which Roman arena, known for gladiator fights, can you still visit in Rome? — The Colosseum. Circus Maximus was for chariot races, the Pantheon is a temple.

text: Hvor lang tid går der mellem to olympiske sommerlege?
gloss: How much time passes between two Summer Olympics? — Four years.

text: En pizza er delt i otte lige store stykker. Mette spiser to, og Jonas spiser tre. Hvor stor en del af pizzaen er tilbage?
gloss: A pizza is cut into eight equal slices. Mette eats two and Jonas three. What fraction is left? — 3/8: 8 - 2 - 3 = 3 slices.

text: Hvad betyder navnet København oprindeligt?
gloss: What did the name København originally mean? — 'Merchants' harbour'. The first part is 'køb' (trade, as in købmand), the second 'havn' (harbour).

text: Navnet LEGO er dannet af to danske ord. Hvilke?
gloss: The name LEGO is made from two Danish words. Which? — 'Leg godt' (play well): LEg + GOdt. Only that phrase spells LE-GO.

text: Operahuset i Sydney med sine sejllignende tage blev tegnet af en dansker. Hvem?
gloss: The Sydney Opera House with its sail-like roofs was designed by a Dane. Who? — Jørn Utzon. Henning Larsen designed the Copenhagen Opera.

text: Tallet »halvfjerds« er en forkortelse af »halvfjerdsindstyve«, altså »tyve« gange et vist tal. Hvilket?
gloss: 'Halvfjerds' (70) is short for 'halvfjerdsindstyve', i.e. twenty times some number. Which? — 3½ (halvfjerde = three and a half): 3.5 x 20 = 70.

text: Hvilket berømt cykelløb slutter traditionelt på Champs-Élysées i Paris?
gloss: Which famous cycling race traditionally ends on the Champs-Élysées in Paris? — The Tour de France.

text: Hvilken gas optager planter fra luften, når de laver fotosyntese?
gloss: Which gas do plants take up from the air during photosynthesis? — Carbon dioxide. Oxygen is what they give off.

text: Hvad er halvdelen af et halvt dusin?
gloss: What is half of half a dozen? — 3: a dozen is 12, half a dozen is 6, half of that is 3.

text: Hvilken komponist skrev sin niende symfoni, selv om han var næsten helt døv?
gloss: Which composer wrote his ninth symphony although he was almost completely deaf? — Beethoven (Ninth Symphony, 1824).

text: Hvem skabte detektiven Sherlock Holmes?
gloss: Who created the detective Sherlock Holmes? — Arthur Conan Doyle.

text: Frihedsgudinden i New Yorks havn blev i 1886 en gave til USA. Fra hvilket land?
gloss: The Statue of Liberty in New York harbour became a gift to the USA in 1886. From which country? — France.

text: Ifølge sagnet faldt Dannebrog ned fra himlen under et slag i 1219. I hvilket land foregik slaget?
gloss: According to the legend Dannebrog fell from the sky during a battle in 1219. In which country was it fought? — Estonia (Lyndanisse, near present-day Tallinn).

text: Carlsberg blev grundlagt i 1847 af J.C. Jacobsen. Hvem er bryggeriet opkaldt efter?
gloss: Carlsberg was founded in 1847 by J.C. Jacobsen. Whom is the brewery named after? — The founder's son Carl (plus 'berg', the hill it stands on).

text: Hvilken af Karen Blixens bøger ligger til grund for filmen »Mit Afrika« med Meryl Streep og Robert Redford?
gloss: Which of Karen Blixen's books underlies the film 'Out of Africa' (Danish title 'Mit Afrika')? — 'Den afrikanske farm' (Out of Africa). Babette's Feast is a different film.

text: Hvilken af disse forlystelsesparker regnes for verdens ældste, der stadig er i drift?
gloss: Which of these amusement parks counts as the world's oldest still in operation? — Bakken (Dyrehavsbakken, from 1583), not Tivoli (1843).

text: Klokken er 12 middag i København. Hvad er klokken da normalt i New York?
gloss: It is noon in Copenhagen. What time is it normally in New York? — 06.00: New York is six hours behind (03.00 would be Los Angeles).

text: Hvilken planet har den højeste gennemsnitstemperatur i hele solsystemet?
gloss: Which planet has the highest average temperature in the whole solar system? — Venus: its thick CO2 atmosphere traps heat, so it is hotter than Mercury, which is closer to the Sun.

text: En bakterieklump fordobler sig hvert minut og fylder en flaske på præcis 60 minutter. Hvornår er flasken halvfuld?
gloss: A bacteria colony doubles every minute and fills a bottle in exactly 60 minutes. When is the bottle half full? — 59 minutes: one more doubling fills it.

text: Hvilket af disse dyr er et pattedyr, men lægger alligevel æg?
gloss: Which of these animals is a mammal that nevertheless lays eggs? — The platypus (næbdyr).

text: Picasso og Braque grundlagde i begyndelsen af 1900-tallet en kunstretning, hvor motivet brydes op i geometriske flader. Hvad hedder den?
gloss: Picasso and Braque founded an art movement in the early 1900s in which the subject is broken into geometric planes. What is it called? — Cubism.

text: Man kaster to almindelige terninger og lægger øjnene sammen. Hvilken sum er mest sandsynlig?
gloss: Two ordinary dice are thrown and the pips added. Which sum is most likely? — 7: it can be made 6 ways out of 36 (6 only 5 ways, 12 only one).

text: Ved retskrivningsreformen i 1948 fik et bogstav officiel plads i det danske alfabet og afløste skrivemåden »aa«. Hvilket?
gloss: The 1948 spelling reform gave one letter an official place in the Danish alphabet, replacing the spelling 'aa'. Which? — Å.

text: Odin har to ravne, der hver dag flyver ud i verden og fortæller ham nyt. De hedder Hugin og Munin. Hvad betyder navnene?
gloss: Odin has two ravens, Hugin and Munin, who fly out each day and bring him news. What do the names mean? — Thought and memory.

text: Københavns Universitet blev grundlagt i året MCDLXXIX af en dansk konge. Hvilken?
gloss: The University of Copenhagen was founded in the year MCDLXXIX by a Danish king. Which? — Christian 1.: MCDLXXIX = 1479, within his reign (1448–1481).

text: Fastelavnssøndag falder syv uger før påskedag. Hvis påskedag falder den 20. april, hvilken dato er det så fastelavn?
gloss: Fastelavn Sunday falls seven weeks before Easter. If Easter is on 20 April, what date is Fastelavn? — 2 March (49 days earlier).

text: Det kemiske symbol Pb stammer fra det latinske ord plumbum. Hvilket grundstof er det?
gloss: The chemical symbol Pb comes from the Latin word plumbum. Which element? — Lead (bly); 'plumbum' lives on in 'plumbing'. Phosphorus and platinum are the P-traps.

text: Et glas er fyldt helt op til randen, og en isterning flyder i vandet. Hvad sker der, når isterningen er smeltet?
options: Vandet står stadig helt oppe ved randen
gloss: A glass is filled to the brim and an ice cube floats in it. What happens when it melts? — Nothing: the floating ice displaces exactly its own weight of water, so the level stays the same.

text: Hvem knækkede i 1822 koden til de egyptiske hieroglyffer ved hjælp af Rosettastenen?
gloss: Who cracked the code of Egyptian hieroglyphs in 1822 with the help of the Rosetta Stone? — Jean-François Champollion.

text: Hvilket havdyr har tre hjerter og blåt blod?
gloss: Which sea animal has three hearts and blue blood? — The octopus (blæksprutte).

text: Hvem skrev romanen »Hundrede års ensomhed« om familien Buendía?
gloss: Who wrote the novel 'One Hundred Years of Solitude' about the Buendía family? — Gabriel García Márquez.

text: Hvilket af disse krydderier udvindes af frugten fra en orkidé?
gloss: Which of these spices is obtained from the fruit of an orchid? — Vanilla. Saffron is a crocus, cardamom a ginger relative, cinnamon is bark.

text: Hvilken dansk forfatter fik Nobelprisen i litteratur i 1944?
gloss: Which Danish author won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1944? — Johannes V. Jensen. Pontoppidan won in 1917; Blixen and Nexø never did.

text: Grundstoffet hafnium er opkaldt efter en dansk by via byens latinske navn, Hafnia. Hvilken by?
gloss: The element hafnium is named after a Danish city via its Latin name, Hafnia. Which city? — Copenhagen: Hafnia comes from the Old Norse word for harbour, as in 'havn'.

text: Hvilken dansk komponist skrev i 1916 sin fjerde symfoni, »Det uudslukkelige«?
gloss: Which Danish composer wrote his Fourth Symphony, 'The Inextinguishable', in 1916? — Carl Nielsen.

text: Hvilken dansker opfandt i 1898 telegrafonen, den første magnetiske lydoptager?
gloss: Which Dane invented the telegraphone, the first magnetic sound recorder, in 1898? — Valdemar Poulsen. La Cour (wind power), Jensen (loudspeaker) and Malling-Hansen (writing ball) are other Danish inventors.

text: En »maximum break« i snooker er den perfekte serie: alle 15 røde bolde hver efterfulgt af den sorte, og derefter alle farverne fra gul til sort. Hvor mange point giver den?
gloss: A 'maximum break' in snooker is 15 reds each followed by the black, then all colours from yellow to black. How many points? — 147: 15 x (1 + 7) = 120, plus 2+3+4+5+6+7 = 27.

text: Hvilken af disse hovedstæder ligger længst mod nord?
gloss: Which of these capitals lies farthest north? — Helsinki (about 60.2°N), just ahead of Oslo (59.9°N); Tallinn and Stockholm are further south.

text: Hvilken hollandsk maler skabte »Pigen med perleørering«?
gloss: Which Dutch painter created 'Girl with a Pearl Earring'? — Johannes Vermeer.

text: De ål, man fanger i danske åer og fjorde, begynder deres liv langt væk. I hvilket hav gyder de europæiske ål?
gloss: The eels caught in Danish streams and fjords begin life far away. In which sea do European eels spawn? — The Sargasso Sea.

text: Hvilket land har flest tidszoner, når man regner dets oversøiske områder med?
gloss: Which country has the most time zones when its overseas territories are counted? — France (12, or 13 with Antarctica), ahead of Russia and the USA (11 each).

text: Hvilken film regnes for den første spillefilm med synkroniserede sangnumre og tale?
gloss: Which film counts as the first feature film with synchronised songs and speech? — The Jazz Singer (1927). Metropolis (1927) was silent.
